hero.title: Transforming Lives Through Education
hero.subtitle: Empowering talented students to achieve their dreams through quality education and mentorship since 2022.

foundingStory.title: Why we began
foundingStory.paragraph1: Perhit Siksha (earlier CLSI) was founded in 2022 as a forum dedicated to breaking the cycle of poverty through education. Since then, we have been transforming the lives of promising children across India.
foundingStory.paragraph2: We believe every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and achieve their dreams. So we provide direct financial support to families while preserving their dignity: removing barriers to quality education by addressing both financial constraints and emotional support needs, and creating sustainable pathways for students to break generational cycles of poverty.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.intro: Perhit Siksha (earlier CLSI) is a forum dedicated to breaking the cycle of poverty through education. Since 2022, we've been transforming the lives of promising children across India.

approach.title: Our Approach
approach.paragraph1: We believe in providing direct financial support to families while preserving their dignity. Our approach removes barriers to quality education by addressing both financial constraints and emotional support needs.
approach.paragraph2: Operating primarily in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, and Andhra Pradesh, we create sustainable pathways for students to achieve their educational goals and break generational cycles of poverty.

whyItMatters.title: Why It Matters
whyItMatters.body: Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and achieve their dreams. Education is not just about academics: it's about hope, dignity, and the power to transform entire communities.

impact.title: Our Impact in Numbers
impact.note: Every contribution directly impacts a student's educational journey

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.body: Rigorous monitoring ensures every rupee reaches its intended purpose with complete transparency and measurable impact.

mentorship.title: Holistic Mentorship
mentorship.body: Beyond financial aid, we provide dedicated academic guidance, career counseling, and emotional support throughout their journey.

community.title: Community Connection
community.body: We foster lasting relationships between contributors and students, creating a supportive community that celebrates every milestone.

visionMission.title: Our Vision & Mission
visionMission.subtitle: Guided by our unwavering commitment to educational equity and social transformation

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To empower every promising child by providing opportunities to complete at least intermediate-level education, nurturing their academic potential and paving the way for a brighter, more equitable future.
vision.quote: "Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world." - Nelson Mandela

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.point1: Provide dignified financial aid for education without intermediaries
mission.point2: Offer comprehensive academic and emotional mentorship throughout their journey
mission.point3: Build a transparent, trustworthy platform driven by collective commitment
mission.point4: Enable promising children to transcend socio-economic limitations through education

community.title: With Community
community.body: Building lasting connections that inspire and sustain

values.title: Our Core Values
values.subtitle: The fundamental principles that guide every decision we make and action we take in our mission to transform lives.

educationFirst.title: Education First
educationFirst.body: Education is the cornerstone of social transformation: the most powerful instrument for personal empowerment and community development.

meritNeed.title: Merit & Need
meritNeed.body: We carefully balance academic potential with financial necessity, ensuring our support creates the maximum sustainable impact for promising students.

holisticGrowth.title: Holistic Growth
holisticGrowth.body: Our support extends far beyond financial aid: we nurture academic excellence, career readiness, and personal development for lifelong success.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Every contribution is tracked and reported with complete transparency, ensuring trust and accountability in all our operations and fund utilization.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.subtitle: Key milestones in our mission to democratize education

foundation.title: Foundation
foundation.body: CLSI was established with a vision to transform lives through education and create lasting impact in communities.

fiftyStudents.title: 50 Students
fiftyStudents.body: Reached our first major milestone of supporting 50 promising students, establishing our foundation for growth.

hundredStudents.title: 100 Students
hundredStudents.body: Doubled our impact by supporting 100 students across multiple states, expanding our geographical reach.

twoHundredStudents.title: 200+ Students
twoHundredStudents.body: Significantly expanding our reach to support over 200 students while enhancing our mentorship programs and community impact.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: Dedicated individuals working towards educational equity.

cta.title: Ready to Make a Difference?
cta.description: Join us in transforming lives through education. Every contribution creates ripples of change that last generations.

contact.title: Get in Touch
